attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Psychological Examiners (Office of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: APA- and Vermont Psychological Association-sponsored programs pre-approved; large group/formal presentations (min 24 h), small peer group activities, individual activities incl. online courses and readings (max 24 h); VT Jurisprudence Exam may count 1 h
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE documentation required with the first renewal after two years of licensure.
rules.audit_note: Random and targeted audits; deficient licensees get 90 days for a corrective plan; keep records 4 years.
rules.notes: 60 h per 2-year renewal cycle set by OPR, taken within 2 years of renewal; at least 6 h professional psychologist ethics; max 30 h on any one topic; self-help and practice-income courses excluded. Reinstatement: 60 h within 24 months.
rules.legal_basis: Administrative Rules for Psychological Examiners (eff. Jan 15, 2015), Part 8; 26 V.S.A. chapter 55
